decision: Explicit absence-of-learning-goals wording in both descriptions identifies conversation-topic simple effect, not topic-by-instruction omnibus interaction. Direct reported eta-squared .21 replaces .16 from omnibus; no reinterpretation as partial eta or F-derived coefficient. Same-test source p<.001 overlaps coded p<.01 under established bound policy, so no p correction. Raw reviewer blind_right label for p does not override compatible intervals. Original printed metric/glyph retained. Other instruction-present and racial-profiling simple effects separate.
